summary: Implementation plan for Divora Phase 12: porting and unifying the Divora NFT trading agent into the AI Studio workspace, replacing broken sellerConsideration reference pricing and synthetic activity fallbacks with real same-currency collection floor pricing, wiring strict intent validation, OpenSea fulfillment preparation, and Seaport 1.6 RPC simulation into the core pipeline, enforcing duplicate-intent prevention and daily spend limits, and exposing a unified operator console.
